title: Persistent PERMISSION_DENIED errors for gcloud commands despite comprehensive troubleshooting

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue describes Google Cloud IAM permission errors encountered while executing external gcloud CLI commands rather than demonstrating a bug or defect in the gemini-cli codebase. It reports configuration and permission failures without actionable reproduction steps or details relating to gemini-cli itself.
triage_metadata.comment: Hi! Thanks for commenting on this issue, we need more information to triage the bug. The issue description addresses PERMISSION_DENIED errors when executing `gcloud` CLI commands. Could you please clarify how this relates to `gemini-cli` and provide specific reproduction steps, commands, and logs involving `gemini-cli`?
